notes: Unique respondent identifier; maps to person.person_id as the primary key.
Data release cycle metadata; stored as observation with custom concept for survey version.
Interview/examination status; maps to observation. No standard OMOP concept; use custom concept.
Gender: 1=Male (8507), 2=Female (8532). Map directly to person.gender_concept_id.
Age in years at screening; used to derive year_of_birth (screening year - age). Topcoded at 80.
Age in months for 0-24 months; maps to observation with concept for age in months (4265472).
Race/Hispanic origin recode; maps to race_concept_id. Requires mapping to OMOP race concepts (e.g., 8515=Asian, 8516=Black, 8527=White, 0=Hispanic).
Race/Hispanic origin with Asian detail; maps to race_concept_id. Use for more granular race mapping.
Six-month exam period; maps to observation as a season/exam period indicator. No standard concept.
Age in months at exam for 0-19 years; maps to observation with concept for age in months.
Served in US Armed Forces; maps to observation. Use custom concept for military service (e.g., 4328749).
Served in foreign country during conflict; maps to observation with custom concept.
Country of birth (US vs others); maps to person.place_of_birth_concept_id. Use 0 for US-born, custom for others.
US citizenship status; maps to observation. No standard OMOP concept; use custom concept.
Length of time in US; maps to observation as ordinal category. Custom concept needed.
Education level for children/youth 6-19; maps to observation. Use custom concept for grade levels.
Education level for adults 20+; maps to observation. Use standard education concepts (e.g., 4328749).
Marital status; maps to observation with standard concept 4054241 (Marital status).
Pregnancy status at exam; maps to observation. Use custom concept for pregnancy status.
Language of SP interview; maps to observation. Use custom language concept.
Proxy used in SP interview; maps to observation. Custom concept for proxy indicator.
Interpreter used in SP interview; maps to observation. Custom concept.
Language of family interview; maps to observation.
Proxy used in family interview; maps to observation.
Interpreter used in family interview; maps to observation.
Language of MEC interview; maps to observation.
Proxy used in MEC interview; maps to observation.
Interpreter used in MEC interview; maps to observation.
Language of ACASI interview; maps to observation.
Total number in household; maps to observation as count. Custom concept for household size.
Total number in family; maps to observation as count.
Number of children ≤5 in HH; maps to observation.
Number of children 6-17 in HH; maps to observation.
Number of adults ≥60 in HH; maps to observation.
HH reference person's gender; maps to observation. Not the participant's gender.
HH reference person's age; maps to observation.
HH reference person's country of birth; maps to observation.
HH reference person's education; maps to observation.
HH reference person's marital status; maps to observation.
HH reference person's spouse's education; maps to observation.
Full sample 2-year interview weight; maps to observation as a survey weight. Custom concept for NHANES weight.
Full sample 2-year MEC exam weight; maps to observation as a survey weight.
Masked variance pseudo-PSU; design variable for variance estimation, not a clinical attribute. Skip mapping.
Masked variance pseudo-stratum; design variable, skip mapping.
Annual household income range; maps to observation. Use custom concept for income bracket.
Annual family income range; maps to observation.
Ratio of family income to poverty; maps to observation as continuous numeric value. Custom concept for PIR.
